instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\inspect_me.dxf. Import inspect_me.dxf. Draw an inspection coupon outline (0,0)-(150,100), add two horizontal rounded-slot centerlines as SLOT rectangles from (30,60) to (70,72) and (85,60) to (125,72), add four diameter 8 datum holes at the corners (15,15), (135,15), (15,85), and (135,85), and add text ACAD-22. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
